journeys
    ↝ J1     j-bvmq  Sub-agent reports home
        ↳ L1.1   l-21j1  supervisor: spawns an in-process sub-agent
        ↳ L1.2   l-9wde  sub-agent: hits a wall and mails #parent
        ↳ L1.3   l-mfg7  supervisor: is nudged on its next tool call
    ↝ J2     j-pn3v  Cross-project bug report
        ↳ L2.1   l-7fdr  agent in project A: finds a bug that belongs to project B
        ↳ L2.2   l-0x4k  mail: persists it — nobody in B is running                                       delivered by 002
        ↳ L2.3   l-0f9w  agent in project B: is idle in a pane
        ↳ L2.4   l-cwd2  agent in project B: reads, fixes, acks                                           delivered by 002

    ‖ R2     r-42vx  Consumer state lives in a deliveries join, never on the message                      honoured by 002
